headline: Nedbank Acquires 66% Stake in Kenya's NCBA Group for KES 23.2 Billion
summary: South Africa's Nedbank Group completed the acquisition of a 66% controlling stake in Kenyan lender NCBA Group for 23.2 billion Kenyan shillings.
why: Nedbank is one of South Africa's largest financial services groups, and its expansion into East Africa strengthens regional banking integration across the African continent.

impacts.name: NCBA Group
impacts.why: NCBA Group came under controlling ownership following Nedbank's 66% stake purchase.
